W.note: Clean, restrained product cards with real variant chips, sold-out state, and adding/added/error feedback, but there is no cart view beyond a count and the mobile header clips the failed-add checkbox.

X.note: Most complete shopping flow (search, categories, sort, stock limits, cart drawer with steppers, totals and checkout) in a dense five-column grid, though it carries more chrome than the brief asks for and the mobile grid and chips overflow the viewport.

Y.note: Tidy cards with rating, price and an Add button that becomes an inline stepper, plus a working cart drawer and live status, though the mobile search, chips and grid overflow and there is no stock or sold-out handling.

Z.note: Very restrained, but three cards leave most of the desktop canvas empty, the cart is only a text line list with no quantity controls or checkout, the struck-through checked variant reads as disabled, and the mobile header and grid overflow.
